offering_description.value: Albemarle produces lithium compounds for battery material makers and other industrial customers. It also supplies bromine and specialty lithium chemicals to manufacturers in electronics, pharmaceuticals and other industries. It extracts lithium from brines and hard-rock ores and processes bromine-rich brines into industrial chemicals.

primary_products.value: lithium carbonate; lithium hydroxide; specialty lithium reagents; brominated flame retardants; bromine-based drilling and completion fluids

customer_segment.value: B2B: Battery material and cell makers, electronics and plastics manufacturers, pharmaceutical producers, and oilfield companies

end_markets.value: electric vehicle batteries; stationary energy storage; electronics and plastics; pharmaceuticals; oil and gas

revenue_model.value: product sales: Battery-grade lithium compounds and specialty chemicals sold under supply agreements and individual orders

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: Extracts lithium and bromine feedstocks for processing into chemicals sold to industrial customers; OEM / manufacturer: Refines lithium feedstocks and bromine-rich brines into compounds for battery and industrial manufacturers

geography_served.value: global: North America, South America, Europe, East Asia and Australia

specialization.value: related lines: Battery-grade lithium compounds, specialty lithium chemicals and bromine-based chemicals

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Commercial sales teams and supply agreements with battery material makers and industrial customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Mining and brine extraction permits, water rights, chemical handling, and plant emissions and safety rules

notes: The profile assumes the announced sale of control of the refining catalysts business has closed.
